# CWI Discovery Engine — Cumulative Web Inc (cumulativeweb.com)

> CWI Discovery Engine is the machine that makes our data findable by every AI
> on earth: MCP server, embedding matrix, llms.txt briefings, crawler welcomes,
> and the freshness engine — all below, all machine-readable.
> Independent label platform: Music & Film · Clothing · Software & AI Agents.

> Independent label platform: Music & Film · Clothing · Software & AI Agents.
> Built for AI agents first: every section below is a machine-readable surface.
> Contact for business & sync: hp@cumulativeweb.com

## Machine front door (start here)

- Long form of this briefing, with endpoint schemas and examples: https://cumulativeweb.com/llms-full.txt
- AI-queryable API (edge, logged, licensed): https://cwi-machine-data.hp-ace.workers.dev
  - Track search: GET /query?q=<keywords> — e.g. /query?q=post-trap+cyberpunk
  - Crawl deltas: GET /changes?since=<ISO-8601> — what changed since your last crawl
  - Licensing terms (machine-readable): GET /license
  - MCP: POST /mcp — JSON-RPC 2.0; tools: search_catalog, get_track, get_artist, sync_search, semantic_search, get_graph, get_release
    (Status 2026-10-06: LIVE — accepting JSON-RPC calls; 7 tools)
  - Sitemap: GET /sitemap.xml — every machine-readable surface with change frequencies
  - RSS freshness feed: GET /feed.xml — same freshness signals as /changes, for feed readers and polling agents
  - Alias edge domain: https://data.cumulativeweb.com (same API)
- MCP server directories & marketplaces (where AI developers discover and install our MCP server):
  - mcprush — CWI Discovery Engine listing: https://mcprush.com/cumulativewebinc/cwi-discovery-engine-mcp — MCP server marketplace (100,000+ MCP server and agent skill listings); publisher claim approved 2026-10-07 (ref CLM-0075); free listing, security-scanned; developers install the catalog MCP server into Claude, Cursor, VS Code with one CLI command, putting the CWI music catalog inside their AI's context
- Catalog learning surface: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/llms.txt — catalog.json, graph.json, kit.json, EQUIP-GUIDE.md (10-step agent equip guide)
- Agent cards (JSON):
  - https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/.well-known/agent-card.json (catalog graph)
  - https://cumulativeweb.com/sanqa/.well-known/agent-card.json (SANQA suite)
  - https://cumulativeweb.com/br/.well-known/agent-card.json (Brasil, pt-BR)
- Meta Muse connector packages — source: https://github.com/CumulativeWebInc/cwi-muse-connectors
  - agent-deck (Agent Deck Catalog API index) and cuefinder (sync search): submitted for review 2026-09-19 — not approved/listed/featured
- Q&A knowledge base: /answers/ (live 2026-10-05); pt-BR answers: /br/respostas/ (live 2026-10-05)

## Embedding matrix for AI retrieval (workstream H, 2026-10-05)

Pre-computed 384-dim bge-small-en-v1.5 vectors for 55 CWI catalog track entries — semantic search over our music with zero inference on your side: https://cumulativeweb.com/data/catalog-embeddings.json (mirrors: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/embeddings/catalog-embeddings.json and, once deployed, https://cwi-machine-data.hp-ace.workers.dev/embeddings/catalog-embeddings.json). MCP tool semantic_search (POST /mcp on the machine-data worker): q + limit → cosine-ranked tracks; the worker embeds your query with Workers AI @cf/baai/bge-small-en-v1.5, the same model as the matrix. How an agent uses this: fetch the matrix once, embed your queries locally with BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, cosine-rank against the 55 vectors — zero API calls per search. Build provenance and the exact source-text template: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/embeddings/EMBEDDINGS.md.
